findings.detail: Affiliate rollforward ending fair values totaling 355,919,417 were ingested in addition to the 657,323,982 debt-and-equity schedule, exactly explaining the extracted excess.

rationale: The filing's current-period debt-and-equity schedule total is 657,323,982 at table 7 row 25. The extracted position sum is 1,013,243,399, an excess of 355,919,417. That excess exactly equals the separate affiliate rollforward ending fair values: 246,700,365 at table 8 row 17 plus 109,219,052 at table 9 row 14. These rollforward disclosures are alternate-dimensional reconciliation data, not additional positions, so their inclusion causes a dimension double count. The full-investments total of 1,239,482,127 includes cash equivalents and short-term investments and is outside the private debt-and-equity position scope.
